# Tabs in a git worktree of their own (tests/run.sh makes the repository
# at @REPO@): New Tab in Worktree… asks a branch and opens a tab there;
# closing it asks whether the worktree goes too. So does closing a tab
# working in one the command line made; one you keep isn't asked about again.
type:cd @REPO@
key:enter
wait:1.0
action:new_tab_in_worktree
wait:0.5
expect-sheet:yes
sheet-type:feat-x
sheet:Create
wait:1.5
expect-tab-count:2
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ worktree list | grep -c feat-x ==> 1
# Ignored through .git/info/exclude: the main checkout has nothing new.
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' ' ==> 0
type:pwd
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:.libertty/worktrees/feat-x
# Closing it with nothing uncommitted: Remove Worktree, and its merged branch goes.
action:close_tab
wait:0.5
expect-sheet:yes
sheet:Remove Worktree
wait:2.0
expect-tab-count:1
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ worktree list | grep -c feat-x ==> 0
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ branch --list feat-x | wc -l | tr -d ' ' ==> 0
# From the command line: a session in one, and gone with --remove-worktree.
type:id=$(libertty +new-session --worktree feat-y) && echo "MADE-$id"
key:enter
wait:3.0
expect:MADE-
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ worktree list | grep -c feat-y ==> 1
type:libertty +kill-session $id --remove-worktree; echo "DONE-$?"
key:enter
wait:5.0
expect:DONE-0
expect:removed
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ worktree list | grep -c feat-y ==> 0
# One the command line made, worked in from another tab: closing that tab
# asks too. Kept, it's yours: the next tab there closes without asking.
type:id2=$(libertty +new-session --worktree feat-z) && echo "MADE2-$id2"
key:enter
wait:3.0
expect:MADE2-
tab:new
wait:1.0
type:cd @REPO@/.libertty/worktrees/feat-z
key:enter
wait:1.0
action:close_tab
wait:1.0
expect-sheet:yes
sheet:Keep Worktree
wait:1.0
expect-tab-count:1
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ worktree list | grep -c feat-z ==> 1
tab:new
wait:1.0
type:cd @REPO@/.libertty/worktrees/feat-z
key:enter
wait:1.0
action:close_tab
wait:1.0
expect-sheet:no
expect-tab-count:1
type:libertty +kill-session $id2 --remove-worktree; echo "DONE2-$?"
key:enter
wait:5.0
expect:DONE2-0
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ worktree list | grep -c feat-z ==> 0
